typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		DATA as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT \'AMERIGROUP_ID,MEMBER_LAST_NAME,MEMBER_FIRST_NAME,MEMBER_PHONE_NUMBER_MOBILE,CAREGIVER_FIRST_NAME,CAREGIVER_LAST_NAME,MEMBER_DOB,COUNTY,PRODUCT_NAME,SUB_PRODUCT_NAME,ASSIGNED_CASE_MANAGER_FIRST_NAME,ASSIGNED_CASE_MANAGER_LAST_NAME,MEMBER_AGE\' AS DATA 		UNION 		SELECT CONCAT(AMERIGROUP_ID 			,\',\',MEMBER_LAST_NAME 			,\',\',MEMBER_FIRST_NAME  			,\',\',MEMBER_PHONE_NUMBER_MOBILE 			,\',\',CAREGIVER_FIRST_NAME 			,\',\',CAREGIVER_LAST_NAME 			,\',\',MEMBER_DOB 			,\',\',COUNTY  			,\',\',PRODUCT_NAME                                                  ,\',\',SUB_PRODUCT_NAME 			,\',\',ASSIGNED_CASE_MANAGER_FIRST_NAME 			,\',\',ASSIGNED_CASE_MANAGER_LAST_NAME 			,\',\',MEMBER_AGE) AS DATA 		 FROM DATA_EXCHANGE.EXTRACT.GA_GOMO_HEALTH_EARLY_DETECTION WHERE ISNULL(REPORT_TYPE,\'\') = \'FC\' 		 ORDER BY 1 DESC',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> SourceEarlyDetectionTableFC	source(output(
		DATA as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT \'AMERIGROUP_ID,MEMBER_LAST_NAME,MEMBER_FIRST_NAME,MEMBER_PHONE_NUMBER_MOBILE,CAREGIVER_FIRST_NAME,CAREGIVER_LAST_NAME,MEMBER_DOB,COUNTY,PRODUCT_NAME,SUB_PRODUCT_NAME,ASSIGNED_CASE_MANAGER_FIRST_NAME,ASSIGNED_CASE_MANAGER_LAST_NAME,MEMBER_AGE\' AS DATA 		UNION 		SELECT CONCAT(AMERIGROUP_ID 			,\',\',MEMBER_LAST_NAME 			,\',\',MEMBER_FIRST_NAME  			,\',\',MEMBER_PHONE_NUMBER_MOBILE 			,\',\',CAREGIVER_FIRST_NAME 			,\',\',CAREGIVER_LAST_NAME 			,\',\',MEMBER_DOB 			,\',\',COUNTY  			,\',\',PRODUCT_NAME                                                  ,\',\',SUB_PRODUCT_NAME 			,\',\',ASSIGNED_CASE_MANAGER_FIRST_NAME 			,\',\',ASSIGNED_CASE_MANAGER_LAST_NAME 			,\',\',MEMBER_AGE) AS DATA 		 FROM DATA_EXCHANGE.EXTRACT.GA_GOMO_HEALTH_EARLY_DETECTION WHERE ISNULL(REPORT_TYPE,\'\') != \'FC\' 		 ORDER BY 1 DESC',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> SourceEarlyDetectionTableNonFC
SourceEarlyDetectionTableFC derive(DATA = DATA) ~> PlaceHolderRowCount
SourceEarlyDetectionTableNonFC derive(DATA = DATA) ~> PlaceHolderRowCount1
PlaceHolderRowCount sink(input(
		DATA as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		DATA)) ~> TargetFFFCEarlyDetection
PlaceHolderRowCount1 sink(input(
		DATA as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		DATA)) ~> TargetFFNonFCEarlyDetection
